definitions.influence: I_i(F)=E[||F−E_i F||²] with E_i averaging input coordinate i
definitions.query: one query reveals one whole input coordinate

claims.title: Bias-independent quadratic influence
claims.claim: For bounded real Hoeffding degree ≤2 functions on independent product inputs, max_i I_i(F) ≥ V²/[256(1+√3)² B²].
claims.mechanism: Pair-interaction matching, mixed differences and bounded signed sums, retaining off-matching terms.
claims.evidence: Written proof and internal checks in the supplied quadratic source package; no external human referee or end-to-end Lean receipt for this full statement.
claims.source_detail: Consolidated editorial paper; original full LaTeX archive is named in README but not reproduced in this checked-in markdown.
claims.audit: Independently reproduce the full matching-core argument with original source files and attack the treatment of off-matching interactions.
limitations: No general degree-three or all-degree exponent-two theorem

claims.title: Adaptive versus fixed whole-coordinate queries
claims.claim: For the paper's unit-ball rank-≤r minimax regime at 0<η≤1/4, degree-two adaptive query complexity is proposed Θ(r/η); for alphabets of size ≤m, the fixed-query order is proposed Θ(rm/η).
assumptions: specified finite alphabet cap m for fixed-query comparison
claims.mechanism: Posterior variance descent, conditional influence selection, replicated address-variable lower constructions.
claims.evidence: Supplied paper proof and internal checks; full quantitative and Hilbert-valued dependencies require independent reproduction.
claims.source_detail: Section 3; original queries.tex and matching-core.tex named but not imported here as complete derivations.
claims.audit: Verify deterministic policy, stopping rule, all constants and Hilbert-rank lift against a separate checker; reconstruct lower families.
limitations: Minimax rates do not describe every single function
No universal adaptive Θ(r/η) theorem at arbitrary degree

claims.title: Two-draw certificate transfer on finite products
claims.claim: The companion reports a finite heterogeneous-product general-degree influence bound of order V^(5/2)/d^6 and a localized certificate-overlap theorem, using imported cube inequalities.
assumptions: bounded outputs and explicitly scoped certificate rows
Turturean's imported cube and weighted antipodal theorems
claims.mechanism: Condition two independent product draws on unordered coordinate pairs to obtain independent fair orientations; import antipodal bounds; optimize certificate weights.
claims.evidence: Companion reports kernel-compiled finite statements in source checkpoint. The separate seven-declaration early formalization establishes only sublemmas and conditional implications. Full later receipts have not been independently replayed in this site pass.
claims.source_detail: Reported receipt in supplied frontier ZIP; page does not assert that the full original Lean bundle is present in this repository.
claims.audit: Import original Lean files and pinned toolchain, compare theorem statements and hypotheses, reproduce full kernel receipts and imported dependencies.
limitations: No independent Lean replay recorded here
Measurable infinite-product and quantum-query extensions are separate written claims
The quadratic manuscript is not implied by this finite theorem

claims.title: Higher-order matching and a cubic moment obstruction
claims.claim: A matching-support amplitude budget and section-oscillation bound are proved in the note. The rare-gate construction Z=(U−p)Σ_j B_j refutes a distribution-independent fourth-moment bound for overlapping degree-two increments.
assumptions: finite product and bounded degree for structural lemmas
U∼Bernoulli(p), independent fair signs B_j for counterexample
claims.mechanism: Independent disjoint supports preserve parity-coupled cancellations; a shared rare coordinate invalidates a naive overlapping-increment moment estimate.
claims.evidence: Elementary mathematical arguments and explicit counterexample in the checked-in note; no independent human referee or claimed Lean theorem.
claims.source_detail: Explicit exact moment formulas and two elementary structural lemmas.
claims.audit: Independently check parity-coupling assumptions, section-oscillation constants and exact fourth moments; test codegree-sensitive replacements against rare-gate stars.
limitations: Refutes a proposed proof operator, not the degree-three influence conjecture
Global originality and referee review open
